_doc: Real-world track facts used by tests and the game. Each has a source note. 'verify' = could not be checked against a primary source from the build environment (see docs/PROGRESS.md).

lapLengthM.source: Published circuit length (7.004 km), as carried in bacinger/f1-circuits 'length' property; widely published by the circuit and championship.

cornerCount.source: Commonly published Grand Prix circuit map (19 turns).

direction.source: Circuit layout; confirmed by negative signed area of the centerline.

elevationChangeM.source: Commonly cited ~102 m total elevation change (lowest near Stavelot, highest near Les Combes). verify

pitLaneSpeedLimitKmh.source: Sporting Regulations default pit-lane speed limit (Race Director may change per event). verify
